# appsignal_apps (Data Source)

Use this data source to look up every app of the organization configured on the provider.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Get every app of the organization configured on the provider
data "appsignal_apps" "all" {}

# The apps are keyed by ID, so they can be iterated over directly
resource "appsignal_log_source" "default" {
  for_each = data.appsignal_apps.all.apps

  app_id = each.key

  name = "default"
  fmt  = "AUTODETECT"
  type = "application"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `apps` (Attributes Map) Every app of the organization, keyed by app ID. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--apps))
- `organization_slug` (String) The slug of the organization the apps were listed from, as configured on the provider.

<a id="nestedatt--apps"></a>
### Nested Schema for `apps`

Read-Only:

- `created_at` (String) The timestamp when the app was created.
- `environment` (String) The environment of the app.
- `id` (String) The ID of the app.
- `name` (String) The name of the app.
- `updated_at` (String) The timestamp when the app was updated.
